name: focusforge
description: FocusForge — Student study planner and productivity tracker monorepo

scripts.build: npm --prefix packages/shared run build && npm --prefix apps/web run build && npm --prefix apps/api run build
scripts.build:web: npm run build --workspace=@focusforge/shared && npm run build --workspace=web
scripts.build:api: npm run build --workspace=@focusforge/shared && npm run build --workspace=api
scripts.test: npm --prefix apps/web run test && npm --prefix apps/api run test
scripts.lint: npm --prefix apps/web run lint && npm --prefix apps/api run lint
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix packages/shared run typecheck && npm --prefix apps/web run typecheck && npm --prefix apps/api run typecheck
